Definition: Shamir, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Shamir = "a point" or "thorn"; n pr loc; 1) a town in the mountain district of Judah; 2) a town in Ephraim where the judge Tola lived and was buried
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
